title: Welcome to LinkDrop
description: This is your starting point. Click here to open the studio and start building your link-in-bio page in minutes.

title: Navigation Bar
description: Use the top nav to move between the landing page and the studio. Your draft status shows up here too.

title: Studio Step Tabs
description: These four tabs walk you through building your page: Profile, Design, Links, and Publish. Follow them in order or jump around.

title: Set Up Your Profile
description: Start here — add your name, bio, and profile picture. This is what visitors see first on your page.

title: Pick a Theme
description: Choose from five color themes to set the vibe of your page. Each one looks great on both mobile and desktop.

title: Add Your Links
description: Tap this button to add links to your socials, website, or anything else. Drag to reorder them however you like.

title: Publish and Share
description: When you're happy with your page, hit this button to save it and get a short shareable URL instantly.

title: Live Preview Panel
description: See your page update in real time as you edit. Toggle between mobile and desktop views to check how it looks everywhere.
